faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about orders, shipping and pro pricing.

items.a1: Orders are dispatched within 48 to 72 hours. Expect 2 to 4 working days in France, 4 to 8 days internationally depending on destination.
items.a2: Yes, from €150 of purchase in mainland France. Below that, a €6.90 shipping fee applies. A 24h express option is available.
items.a3: You have 30 days to return an unworn item in its original packaging. Refunds are processed within 7 days after receipt.
items.q4: How do I become a reseller / get wholesale pricing?
items.a4: Create a professional account from the wholesale area. After validating your file (within 24 business hours), preferential rates appear automatically on login.
items.q5: What is the MOQ for wholesale orders?
items.a5: MOQ depends on the product family — typically 12 pieces per reference, 24 for earrings. The details are shown on each product sheet and in the pro area.
items.q6: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.a6: Bank card (Visa, Mastercard, AMEX) via Stripe, as well as PayPal. Payment is 100% secure; no card data passes through our servers.
items.a7: Yes, we ship to more than 27 countries (Europe, North America, Asia). Any taxes or customs duties outside the EU are the responsibility of the recipient.

shipping.title: Shipping & returns
shipping.subtitle: Delivery times, zone pricing and return conditions.
shipping.delaysText: All orders are prepared in our workshops and shipped within 48 to 72 working hours. A tracking number is sent by email as soon as the carrier takes charge.
shipping.customs: Customs duties and taxes outside the European Union are the responsibility of the recipient.
shipping.returnsText: You have 30 days from receipt to return an unworn item in its original packaging. Contact us to receive a return label; the refund is issued within 7 days after receipt and inspection of the item.
shipping.customOrders: Personalised pieces and wholesale orders (B2B) follow specific conditions, specified at order confirmation.
